title: Hamburger Buns
description: Soft, golden, and pillowy — the perfect base for your ultimate burger creations.

ingredients.item: Optional glaze: splash of milk before baking, or melted butter after

method.instruction: In a large bowl, combine lukewarm liquid (milk/water), sugar, and instant yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until foamy.
Add flour, salt, and oil. Mix until a rough dough forms.
Knead for 8-10 minutes (by hand or in a stand mixer) until the dough is smooth, soft, and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1-1.5 hours or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide into 8 equal pieces (approximately 105-110g each).
Shape each piece into a smooth ball by tucking the edges underneath, then flatten slightly into a disc shape.
Place buns on a lined baking tray, leaving space between each (they will expand).
Cover and let rise for 45-60 minutes until puffy and nearly doubled.
Brush tops lightly with milk and sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the tops are golden brown but still soft.
Remove from oven and brush with melted butter for extra softness (optional).
Cool on a wire rack before slicing horizontally for burgers.

notes.title: Perfect Shape
notes.content: For uniform buns, weigh each dough portion to ensure they're all the same size (105-110g each).

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2-3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months. Thaw and warm before using.

notes.title: Brioche-Style
notes.content: For richer, brioche-style buns, replace water with all milk and add 1 beaten egg to the dough.
